# Devaxl

> Devaxl is an AI-native product studio that designs, builds, and scales SaaS and AI products for founders and CTOs. We embed a single senior squad — design, engineering, and product — and ship to production in weeks, not quarters. Clients own all code, design, and infrastructure from day one.

Devaxl is a services company, not a software product. Engagements start with a short scoping call, then a fixed-fee discovery that returns a written plan with scope, timeline, and team.

## What Devaxl does

- **SaaS & AI MVP to launch** — takes an idea to a production v1 real users can pay for. A focused MVP reaches production in roughly 8–12 weeks.
- **AI product engineering** — RAG and semantic search, agents and copilots, LLM pipelines, plus the evals and guardrails that keep them accurate, safe, and cost-controlled in production.
- **Scale & modernize** — performance, reliability, and incremental zero-downtime rollout for slow or brittle platforms already serving users.
- **Embedded product team** — a dedicated senior squad working inside the client's org, tools, and rituals against their roadmap.

## Engagement models

- **MVP Build** — fixed-scope, fixed-timeline delivery. Design, engineering, and QA included.
- **Dedicated Team** — embedded senior squad, billed monthly. Design, frontend, backend, and PM.
- **Modernization Retainer** — ongoing performance and reliability program with architecture guidance.

## Facts

- 21+ products shipped to production.
- 27 five-star client reviews (Upwork and Fiverr).
- Clients own all IP, code, and infrastructure from day one; work-for-hire terms with mutual NDAs; client code is never reused across engagements.
- Industries: fintech, B2B SaaS, health, marketplaces, AI, internal tools.
- Remote-first, working with founders and CTOs worldwide.
- Contact: sales@devaxl.com
